trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all regions. Rollback verified: service is now healthy with error rate back to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so a re-deploy of it would require change-manager approval per policy.
